latestVersion.changelog: 文章链接提取工具。提交付费媒体文章链接，自动匹配已有内容并返回英文全文，或排队提取。支持 Barron's、Bloomberg、Financial Times、Foreign Policy、Handelsblatt、MarketWatch、New York Times、Reuters、The Atlantic、The Economist、The New Yorker、Wall Street Journal、Washington Post、Wired 共 15 家媒体。需要 Import Token 鉴权，每日有次数限制。Article link extraction tool. Supports Barron's, Bloomberg, FT, Foreign Policy, Handelsblatt, MarketWatch, NYT, Reuters, The Atlantic, The Economist, The New Yorker, WSJ, Washington Post, Wired (15 outlets). Requires Import Token.
